sentences.text: The noon-only plan was changed because rain disrupted the noon visit, leading to the adoption of morning and noon observations.
sentences.quote:
Use morning and noon observations after rain disrupted the noon visit. This replaces the noon-only plan; better sampling accuracy has not been measured.
2024-05-19T11:00:00Z Rain interrupts the noon visit.
2024-05-20T08:00:00Z Maya adopts morning and noon observations.

sentences.text: Better accuracy was not established when the plan changed from noon-only to morning and noon sampling.
sentences.quote:
Better sampling accuracy has not been measured.
No accuracy comparison was run.

sources.title: Noon-only sampling proposal
sources.body:
# Study plan, version 1
Controlled plan, 2024-05-18. Count visits at noon only. Maya proposed noon because the path is quieter. Proposal, not a measured best time.

sources.title: Morning and noon sampling decision
sources.body:
# Study plan, version 2
Controlled decision, 2024-05-20. Use morning and noon observations after rain disrupted the noon visit. This replaces the noon-only plan; better sampling accuracy has not been measured.

sources.title: Why the sampling plan changed
sources.body:
# Controlled study reasoning
2024-05-18T09:00:00Z Maya proposes noon-only visits.
2024-05-19T11:00:00Z Rain interrupts the noon visit.
2024-05-20T08:00:00Z Maya adopts morning and noon observations. No accuracy comparison was run.
